scope: Single-use eight-song individual-person-disjoint Phase 94 test. The immutable original checkpoint and the fixed 0.60-second release-preserving overlap candidate are decoded from the same audio before MIDI labels are authorized.
primaryMetric: continuous-song strict exact-pitch onset micro-F1 at 100 ms

certificationCheck.failureMeaning: The test is consumed and the candidate cannot support a broad 90-percent direct-piano transcription claim. Thresholds may not be relaxed after the result.

custodyRequirements: opened Kiss Me blind candidate preference recorded before mapping reveal
test audio materialized without MIDI labels
primary and overlap predictions hash-locked before MIDI authorization
candidate and immutable original scored against the same reference manifest
all eight test songs included exactly once
failed test permanently becomes opened development evidence

claimBoundary.route: clean or piano-dominant audio to literal piano notes
doesNotCertify: full commercial music mix to Pianella-style arrangement
